subject: Matemática
description_pt: Reconhecer a abertura do ângulo como grandeza associada às figuras geométricas.

components.description_pt: Reconhecer a medida de um ângulo como uma quantidade associada à abertura de um ângulo
components.description_en: Recognize angle measure as a quantity associated with the opening of an angle
components.cc_component_description: Recognize that an angle is measured with reference to a circle with its center at the common endpoint of the rays

components.description_pt: Associar a medida de um ângulo a figuras geométricas que contêm ângulos
components.description_en: Associate angle measure with geometric figures containing angles
components.cc_component_description: Use a protractor accurately to measure angles in geometric figures

cc_matches.description: *Recognize angles as geometric shapes that are formed wherever two rays share a common endpoint, and understand concepts of angle measurement:* an angle is measured with reference to a circle with its center at the common endpoint of the rays, by considering the fraction of the circular arc between the points where the two rays intersect the circle. An angle that turns through 1/360 of a circle is called a "one-degree angle," and can be used to measure angles.
